title: Ani-One Asia Removes Chainsmoker Cat from Their YouTube Channel
content: Yaniko’s troubles continue. Ani-One Asia announced that it will remove Chainsmoker Cat from its YouTube channel. The company mentioned that the removal was due to “local government regulations in local markets” and apologized for any inconvenience.
author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Happy Kanako's Killer Life Season 2 Reveals 3 New Cast Members
content: The DMM TV streaming service announced new cast members for the second season of the live-action series of Toshiya Wakabayashi 's Happy Kanako's Killer Life ( Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu ) manga on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duo' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for the new Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duo ( Fairy Princess Minky Momo ) announced an additional pair of cast on Friday. The OVA is scheduled to open in theaters on November 13.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Ani-One Asia Also Removes Chainsmoker Cat Anime From Streaming Lineup
content: Medialink Entertainment 's anime streaming service Ani-One Asia has removed the television anime of Nyan Nyan Factory 's Chainsmoker Cat ( Yanineko ) manga from its lineup on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Lego One Piece Animated Special's Trailer Highlights Usopp's Tall Tales
content: Netflix streamed the official trailer for the Lego One Piece two-part animated special on Friday. The trailer features Usopp regaling the audience with exaggerated tall tales of the Straw Hat Pirates' adventures.
author: ANN

title: There’s No Perfect Naruto Replacement, but These 4 Anime Can Help Fill That Void
content: It’s been almost a decade since the anime adaptation of Naruto came to an end, but the series still remains one of the medium’s most iconic shonen series . There’s a reason it’s regularly referenced as one of the “Big Three,” and that it’s still such a huge part of the cultural zeitgeist.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe' Unveils Cast Members, Additional Staff, Trailer
content: The official website of the Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms: Die Graue Hexe ) anime unveiled the cast members, additional staff, and main trailer on Friday. The anime will premiere as two movies, with the first one scheduled to open in theaters on November 20.
